title: DesignVersion.diff_from_parent_json and file_hash are unpopulated (null) across multi-revision designs

payload.description:
**Title:** DesignVersion.diff_from_parent_json and file_hash are unpopulated (null) across multi-revision designs

**Context / Module:** DesignVersion / DesignReview

**Description:**
On multi-revision files such as DF-2026-00001 (BEV-BT-2400 Battery Tray Assembly, v1 -> v3), the revision delta metadata (diff_from_parent_json), file_hash, and parent_version_id are null across all version rows.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Call DesignVersion.list or GET /api/v1/design_versions for DF-2026-00001.
2. Inspect version records (v1, v2, v3).

**Expected Result:**
The platform should pre-compute or populate structured geometric/BOM revision diffs in diff_from_parent_json to enable automated revision comparison between parent and child versions.

**Actual Result:**
Fields are null, forcing agents and users to infer changes solely from free-text commit_message strings.

title: CAD analysis endpoints return HTTP 501 Not Implemented (OpenCascade missing)

payload.description:
**Title:** CAD analysis endpoints return HTTP 501 Not Implemented (OpenCascade missing)

**Context / Module:** DesignFile / CAD Analysis Pipeline

**Description:**
Invoking REST endpoints /analysis/thickness and /analysis/interference for any uploaded DesignFile returns HTTP 501: 'needs a CAD kernel (OpenCascade), which this build does not ship'. Additionally, has_brep is 0 across all uploaded CAD files.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Call GET /api/v1/design_files/39b69109-b56a-4bf4-af48-1ecf2b18f8a6/analysis/thickness.
2. Observe HTTP 501 response.

**Expected Result:**
Geometric DFM analysis endpoints should compute ray-cast wall thickness and interference clashing, or provide simulated rule outputs for active designs.

**Actual Result:**
Endpoints return 501, blocking server-side CAD geometric validation.

title: 3D CAD Viewer fails to load GLTF model (HTTP 404 on /api/designreview/files/:id/gltf)

payload.description:
**Title:** 3D CAD Viewer fails to load GLTF model (HTTP 404 on /api/designreview/files/:id/gltf)

**Context / Module:** DesignFile / CADViewer3D

**Description:**
When loading a DesignFile in the web UI, the 3D viewer component (CADViewer3D) attempts to fetch the model from GET /api/designreview/files/{file_id}/gltf. The endpoint responds with HTTP 404 Not Found, causing the Three.js viewport to fail with 'CADViewer3D: Failed to load model: /api/designreview/files/{file_id}/gltf responded with 404'.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Open any DesignFile in the web UI (e.g. DF-2026-00001, ID 39b69109-b56a-4bf4-af48-1ecf2b18f8a6 or 0bc2b05d-f11f-46b6-9b91-463af65eea8e).
2. Inspect the 3D CAD Preview tab and Developer Console (F12).
3. Observe HTTP 404 error fetching /api/designreview/files/{file_id}/gltf.

**Expected Result:**
The backend should serve the converted .gltf/.glb model associated with the active DesignVersion.

**Actual Result:**
Endpoint returns HTTP 404, breaking 3D model visualization in the browser.

title: Automated AI review endpoint returns HTTP 501 Not Implemented across all check types

payload.description:
**Title:** Automated AI review endpoint returns HTTP 501 Not Implemented across all check types

**Context / Module:** DesignAICheck / api:ai-review

**Description:**
Invoking POST /api/designreview/ai-review (or DesignAICheck.create) fails with HTTP 501: 'AI design review is not implemented in this build: it needs a model call that has not been wired up.'

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Send a POST request to /api/designreview/ai-review with a valid file_id and review_id.
2. Observe HTTP 501 response.

**Expected Result:**
The backend should trigger automated AI checks (DFM analysis, GD&T validation, and lessons learned) and populate DesignAICheck finding records.

**Actual Result:**
Returns HTTP 501, preventing automated server-side AI design verification.

title: DesignComparison silently misses non-part-count geometric and feature revision deltas

payload.description:
**Title:** DesignComparison silently misses non-part-count geometric and feature revision deltas

**Context / Module:** DesignComparison / DesignReview

**Description:**
When comparing two versions of a part (e.g. rev 2 -> rev 3 of DF-2026-00001), DesignComparison only checks top-level component count and sets geometry_compared to false. Geometric changes (such as bend radius expanded 2.0mm -> 3.0mm, blank growth 4.2mm) report '0 added, 0 removed, 0 modified'.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Call DesignComparison.create or POST /api/v1/design_comparisons for DF-2026-00001 (v2 vs v3).
2. Inspect response payload.

**Expected Result:**
DesignComparison should detect and surface feature-level and geometric modifications in modified_parts_json.

**Actual Result:**
Reports 0 modified parts and geometry_compared: false, masking real manufacturing deltas.

title: No data models or endpoints for First Article Inspection (FAI) or drawing ballooning artifacts

payload.description:
**Title:** No data models or endpoints for First Article Inspection (FAI) or drawing ballooning artifacts

**Context / Module:** DesignFile:Artifacts / DesignReview

**Description:**
Standard manufacturing design review and supplier gating workflows (such as AS9102 / ISO FAI) require generating characteristic ballooned drawings and dimensional inspection tables. Currently, the AgentSwitch designreview seat provides no entities, endpoints, or data models to store drawing balloon coordinates, characteristic index numbers, or dimensional tolerance inspection sheets.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Inspect available entities and endpoints in /api/schemas for seat 'designreview'.
2. Attempt to query or store drawing characteristic balloons or FAI tables.

**Expected Result:**
The platform should provide schema entities (e.g. DesignInspection, DesignDrawingBalloon) and endpoints to capture and export structured FAI inspection packages.

**Actual Result:**
No entities or endpoints exist for FAI or drawing ballooning.

title: DesignReview state machine is monolithic and lacks atomic change-by-change approval states

payload.description:
**Title:** DesignReview state machine is monolithic and lacks atomic change-by-change approval states

**Context / Module:** DesignReview / DesignFeedback

**Description:**
In multi-revision engineering changes (e.g. rev B -> rev C), reviewers frequently need to approve specific changes while rejecting or requesting rework on others. Currently, DesignReview only supports a monolithic file-level state machine (draft -> in_review -> approved / rejected). Individual DesignFeedback items only have resolution statuses (open -> in_progress -> resolved), but lack an explicit approval_decision field ('approved', 'rejected', 'pending') tied to discrete revision delta items.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Create a DesignReview for a multi-change revision.
2. Attempt to record granular sign-offs on individual delta items.

**Expected Result:**
Reviewers should be able to record granular sign-offs on individual delta items and feedback threads within a review.

**Actual Result:**
State transition is coarse and all-or-nothing at the review level.

title: DesignFeedback and review history cannot be queried across projects for historical defect precedents

payload.description:
**Title:** DesignFeedback and review history cannot be queried across projects for historical defect precedents

**Context / Module:** DesignFeedback / DesignReview:Search

**Description:**
Engineering review teams require historical precedent lookups (e.g., 'Have we encountered flange cracking or tooling clearance issues on similar battery tray sheet metal parts in past projects?'). Currently, DesignFeedback.list and DesignReview.list require filtering by specific file_id or review_id. The platform lacks a cross-project semantic search or keyword query endpoint across historical feedback and checklist failures, siloing engineering lessons in individual project records.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Attempt to query DesignFeedback across multiple files or projects via API/MCP.
2. Observe requirement for specific file_id / review_id filter.

**Expected Result:**
A cross-file/cross-project query endpoint to search historical feedback, defect tags, and checklist failure root causes.

**Actual Result:**
Feedback remains strictly isolated within single design files.
